en: Black-and-white postcard view of a semi-rural street lined with early 20th‑century villas and houses behind fences and gardens. In the foreground is a grassy field. On the left is a large house with a small cross on the roof, and to the right are additional gabled houses, one with a small tower-like corner structure. The scene is calm and residential. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the street name.
